children: New Delhi, Sept. 25 -- Welspun Corp share price climbed over 4% in early deals on the BSE on Friday, 25 September, boosted by the company's announcement about its subsidiary winning its largest-ever order in the US.
Welspun Corp shares opened at Rs.2,782 against their previous close of Rs.2,694.60 and rose by 4.3% to an intraday high of Rs.2,810.
